summary: Wall Street fell sharply Friday as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's sudden resignation sent shockwaves through technology stocks, compounding pressure from persistent inflation and hawkish Fed rhetoric. The Nasdaq led declines, down 1.6% intraday, with chip stocks plunging after Huang stepped down amid reports of extramarital affairs including one involving a suspected Chinese spy. Producer price inflation hit 6.5% annually—the highest since November 2022—following October's hotter-than-expected core CPI, reinforcing expectations that the Fed will resume rate hikes at upcoming meetings. San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly confirmed Thursday that further tightening will likely be needed, while BofA now expects hikes at the next three FOMC meetings. Bitcoin extended losses below $69,000 as crypto ETFs hemorrhaged $1.44 billion over five consecutive days, with BlackRock's IBIT accounting for most outflows. Treasury yields climbed to 5.10%, adding pressure to equity valuations as the VIX spiked 6.9% to 18.70.

signals.title: Nvidia CEO Huang Resigns Amid Scandal, Shares Sink 14% from Nov 6 Peak
signals.desc: Jensen Huang's sudden exit over extramarital affairs including suspected Chinese spy involvement triggered broad tech selloff with AMD down 10.7% and chip sector cratering.

signals.title: Producer Price Inflation Surges to 6.5%, Highest Since 2022
signals.desc: PPI jumped to highest rate since November 2022, far exceeding 4% consumer inflation and signaling businesses may pass costs to consumers as Fed hike cycle resumes.

signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $1.44B in Five Days, BlackRock IBIT Leads Exodus
signals.desc: US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted fifth straight day of outflows with IBIT shedding $269.7M Wednesday alone as BTC fell below $69,000 for first time since August.

signals.title: Fed's Daly Signals More Rate Hikes Needed, BofA Calls Three Consecutive Increases
signals.desc: San Francisco Fed President confirmed further tightening likely as businesses contemplate price hikes; BofA now forecasts Fed hikes at next three meetings through early 2027.

signals.title: Treasury Yields Hit 5.10% as Fed Meeting Schedule Restructured for 2027
signals.desc: 10-year yields climbed to 5.10% pressuring tech valuations while Fed Chairman Warsh announced October 2027 meeting will skip rate vote for strategic policy review.

verdict: Risk-off sentiment dominates as Nvidia's leadership crisis, sticky inflation prints, and Fed hawkishness converge to pressure equities and crypto into year-end.
